script.text: His plans thwarted, Roget attempted to escape through a dimensional transporter.
You know you've been beaten, Roget! A scared little puppy dog scurrying back to Duel Academy!
This is not a retreat, missy! This is a minor setback! But I will return!
I don't think so, Roget. You won't have a chance to come back, because you're never leaving here.
Why do you think Duel Academy sent me here?
Because I alone was capable of conquering this dimension, just as I will conquer you!
